explication: Stitch Design Skills is a catalog of agent-invoked workflows for creating, extracting, managing, and reusing Stitch designs, plus generating code and media from them. The main design path converts frontend code into HTML, captures design-system guidance, and uploads assets to Stitch; separate skills generate or edit designs directly. Build skills turn Stitch screens into framework components or walkthrough videos, while utilities support prompt refinement and design documentation. Edges reflect README-documented workflows or the upload script’s explicit API call; unsampled skill instructions may contain additional sequencing not shown here.
